title: Re-run of X2/R0 on a unit-consistent market cap after the share-basis STOP finding
authority: Owner directive 2026-08-07. DEC-291. Red-team finding fh-20260807-036 ISSUE 1 (STOP, future-information leak via mixed share bases), handler-verified from the panel itself before this freeze: AAPL shares 4,275,634,000 -> 17,001,802,000 between origins 2020-09-18 and 2020-12-18 (ratio 3.98 = the 2020-08-31 4:1 split) while the price series is continuous across that split; data/yf/finance/AAPL.json data.splits carries {2020-08-31: 4}. Public surface stays KEEP_QUARANTINED.
status_of_prior_runs: R0 v1 and v2 verdicts are VOID - not superseded by an inference choice, but because every valuation ratio they consumed (B/P, V/P via mcap) mixed a split-adjusted-to-today price basis with an as-reported-at-origin share basis. 274/848 member-origin cells affected (red-team count, to be re-verified). X2's published ICs and DEC-290's factual premise ('RIM does rank returns; B/P ranks better') are equally affected. Returns (tr) are unaffected - they use the price series only. Stated before this run's results are known.
independent_red_team: cc (Claude Code) - offered and accepted: independent end-to-end re-derivation of the corrected panel and statistics in parallel; handler and red team compare after both finish, neither reads the other's corrected artifact first.

correction_rule_precommitted.diagnosis: mc_panel = price_today_basis * shares_as_reported_at_share_fact_period_end. For any split dated after the share fact's period end, mc is understated by exactly the cumulative split factor; the factor is post-origin information, which ranks firms that later split (i.e. rose) as cheapest - a look-ahead leak.
correction_rule_precommitted.correction: For each member-origin cell: F = product of split ratios in data/yf/finance/{SYM}.json data.splits whose split date is STRICTLY AFTER the period_end of the EDGAR share fact used for that cell. shares_corrected = shares_panel * F. mc_corrected = price * shares_corrected. B/P and V/P recomputed on mc_corrected. Nothing else changes: V construction, returns, member filters, origin sets stay verbatim X2.
correction_rule_precommitted.share_fact_period_end_recovery: The e2 basket panel does not store the period_end of the share fact it used. It is re-derived per member-origin with the same PIT rule the panel builder applied (facts filed <= origin, earliest filed per period) from data/edgar/rim-dow/{SYM}.json CommonStockSharesOutstanding, matching the panel's shares value; if a symbol's cache cannot reproduce the panel shares value for a cell, that cell is dropped from the corrected run and counted (no approximation).
correction_rule_precommitted.edge_cases: Origin after a split with a pre-split share fact (AAPL 2020-09-18): F still includes that split because split date > share fact period_end - the economically correct share count at the origin date is the fact times known split events. Splits dated before the share fact period_end are excluded. Spinoff-related adjustments are not in data.splits and are NOT corrected; affected symbols (red team lists HON IBM MMM MRK at factors 1.05-1.20) are disclosed as residual uncorrected cells in the artifact.
unit_consistency_assertions_gate: After correction, AAPL mc at origin 2015-03-27 must lie within 5% of price*shares recomputed independently (red team's external value ~718B; recorded value was 183.3B)
No-split control symbols (JPM 2015-03-27 ~224B, KO ~178B, MMM ~89B) unchanged within 1%
For every corrected cell, F equals the closed-form product of dated splits - no manual overrides

statistics_contract: Identical to r0-criteria-v2 (commit c94a4ffb01): reproduction gate ordinal+cardinal, ESS-adjusted CI + NW lag 11 primary with ESS clamp >=3 and <=T diagnostic, block battery sensitivity with independent-block counts and block-12-on-T=18 degeneracy note, partial-correlation R0-B primary, combined mean-S R0-D test, disagreement rule, instrument-free 12-phase binomials, survivorship bound. The ONLY input change is mc_corrected in the B/P and V/P ratios.
verdict_mapping: Identical to r0-criteria-v2 (POSITIVE/NEGATIVE written in full, ZERO declared unreachable with minimum detectable effect, INCONCLUSIVE otherwise, disagreement rule). Applied to the corrected series. The artifact must also restate: which prior conclusions survive (none of the ratio-based ones) and what the corrected evidence says in both directions.
prohibitions: No change to V construction, returns, filters, sets, seeds, lags, bands or mapping.
No post-result choice of correction scope (spinoff cells stay uncorrected and disclosed).
No overwriting prior artifacts; corrected results go to *_CORRECTED files.
No public number republication; quarantine untouched.
